name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix + graphics domain + descriptor bg_anim_flip_flag accurately reflects purpose (background-animation every-other-frame flip) and data type (_flag). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix tied to 0x53A40 or any data address). No domain ID involved. Matches sibling graphics flags in rndscene.c.
purpose: Background-animation every-other-frame flip flag (value 0/1) used by the battle tile-map render path to alternate animated tile sprites once per BIOS tick.
logic_summary: Owned/driven by fd2_composite_battle_tile_map: on each BIOS-tick change (signed word @ 0x46C) it toggles flag ^= 1 (the sole writer, READ_WRITE @ 0x11f0f) and latches the tick. Three readers add the flag (or flag*2) onto a tile id to swap animated tile sprites: fd2_composite_battle_tile_map at 0x121e6 (attr bit 0x04 -> tile_id += flag) and 0x12258 (attr bit 0x08 -> tile_id += flag*2), and fd2_blit_animated_tile_at_pos at 0x12b61 (attr bit 0x08 -> tile_id += flag*2).
element_semantics: Single 32-bit scalar slot holding a 0/1 toggle. Read as a dword; the writer (^= 1) only ever touches the low byte, so the value never leaves {0,1} and the upper 3 bytes stay zero.
notes: Memory image at 0x53A40 is all-zero (BSS, zero-init). 4 xrefs total (1 READ_WRITE writer + 3 READ). is_const=false because of the genuine game-side write (flag ^= 1) in fd2_composite_battle_tile_map. src comment block (rndscene.c lines 1347-1354) already accurate/precise -> keep, no Edit to source (so rndscene.c is not staged). Ghidra data PLATE_COMMENT was empty (<null>) -> created via run_script_inline + cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...), content aligned to src conclusion.
